The '''Hoovers''' were a small, quadruped [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], little-known throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were [[Color/Legends|brown]] with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and disproportionately large trunks; with this, some [[Diet/Legends|sucked]] the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] of other sentients. Hoovers could become sophisticated [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], utilizing their tiny size to effect repairs from inside machinery. The technician [[Attark/Legends|Attark]], a pet of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] who lived in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], was a Hoover.

==Biology and appearance==
The Hoovers were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of quadrupeds with each of their [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] ending in [[Color/Legends|black]], cloven hooves. They had a disproportionately long snout compared to their small body size.<ref name="CSWE57">{{CSWECite|II|57|Hoover}}</ref> Hoovers could use these snouts&mdash;also known as nose trunks&mdash;to slither through clothing and around blankets. It also enabled them to [[Diet/Legends|suck]] the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] of sleeping victims, belying their otherwise harmless appearance. They had two large,<ref name="CSWE47" /> black, pupiless [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="CCG" /> pointed ears, a wide [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], and a small tail. A narrow ridge began at the top of their heads and ran down their backs to their tails. At least some Hoovers had brown skin, which was heavily wrinkled.<ref name="CSWE47" />

==History==
{{Quote|I am taking Captain Solo and his friends. You can either profit by this or be destroyed. It's your choice, but I warn you not to underestimate my powers.|Luke Skywalker, to Jabba the Hutt|<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
[[File:Attark.png|thumb|left|Attark the Hoover]]
To the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the Hoovers were a mysterious<ref name="CSWE47" /> and little-known species.<ref name="CSWE57" /> They were part of the [[galactic community]] by<ref name="CSWE47" /> at least [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] take place in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> when the Hoover [[Attark/Legends|Attark]] was a member of the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] court of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Although considered to be a pet of the Hutt,<ref name="CSWE47" /> he had tremendous [[Technician/Legends|technical abilities]], and, due to his small size, was able to manipulate detailed electronics,<ref name="CCG" /> sometimes crawling inside machinery to repair it from within.<ref name="WW">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> During the night, Attark drank the blood of other members of Jabba's retinue.<ref name="CSWE47" /> He was present<ref name="CCG" /> when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|infiltrated]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] to rescue a [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-encased [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], an event which subsequently led to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Jabba and the splintering of his [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Hoover_bts.jpg|thumb|right|An early color scheme for the Hoover]]
The Hoover was created as a maquette for the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], released in [[1983]]; however, the creature cannot be seen in the film nor its presence recalled by several of the puppeteers from the set.<ref name="Pablo">{{SW|url=news/return-of-the-jedi-creature-history-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=''Return of the Jedi'' Creature History with Pablo Hidalgo|nolive=1}}</ref> He was given the moniker "Hoover" by the creature shop of [[Industrial Light & Magic]],<ref name="WW" /> from as early as [[1981]].<ref name="Pablo" /> The maquette for the Hoover was created by ILM employee [[Dave Carson]].<ref name="Masters">{{InsiderCite|231|Maquette Masters}}</ref>

Given the creature's long trunk, the name Hoover was likely a reference to the [[Wikipedia:The Hoover Company|Hoover]] vacuum cleaner.<ref name="WW" /> A second nickname found in the original design sketches for this creature was "Dogephant." The puppet was to be operated by a puppeteer's arm through the floor. A dummy maquette shows that propmakers considered painting him a light purple with red spots on his back; he was later colored brown.<ref name="SWC">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> The maquette ended up in the Lucasfilm Archives sporting a blonde wig.<ref name="Pablo" />

Reference books such as ''[[Return of the Jedi Monster Activity Book]]'' (1983),<ref name="Activity book">''[[Return of the Jedi Monster Activity Book]]''</ref> ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' ([[1994]])<ref name="A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> and [[Star Wars Chronicles|''Star Wars: Chronicles'']] ([[1997]]), treated Hoover as the name of an individual, leaving the species unidentified.<ref name="SWC" /> The [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] ([[1998]]) first identified Hoover as the species, giving the individual in Jabba's Palace the name Attark.<ref name="CCG" /> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' ([[2008]]) has an entry for both Attark<ref name="CSWE47" /> and Hoover; however, it treats Hoover as an individual of the Hoover species, not connecting him with Attark.<ref name="CSWE57" /> This article has treated this as an error.
